questions.stem: A child was brought to the pediatric emergency with complaints of abdominal pain, vomiting, mild abdominal distention, and constipation. On physical examination, there was notable tenderness near the navel. The physician immediately orders some tests, but none of it turns out satisfactory. Hence, after giving initial medications to the child, the physician orders a Meckel's scan to check for Meckel’s diverticulum. Which of the following is true about Meckel’s diverticulum?

options.label: A
options.text: Is found in about 4% of the population.

options.label: B
options.text: Is always found on the antimesenteric border of the ileum.

options.label: C
options.text: Is usually about 2 cm in length.

options.label: D
options.text: Is usually located about 20 cm from the ileocaecal junction.
